subject: Observability add-ons — retention / tracing / dashboards: commitment and pricing offer
messages:
From: Kumar Santos <k.santos@brightscale.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Quick question: observability add-ons pricing for retention + tracing

Hi Camila,

We're doing a refresh of our telemetry and want to understand Redwood's add-on pricing for three areas: log retention beyond the included window, distributed tracing ingest & retention, and the advanced dashboard pack (materialized dashboards + alerts).

Current-ish footprint: ~2M traces/month, 18 TB of log ingested/month, typical query load for dashboards ~400 RPU/day. We're interested in a 12–24 month commitment and would like to see pricing scenarios for:
- 90-day vs 365-day log retention (monthly tiers)
- trace retention 30/90/365 days (per-trace ingest vs flat slab)
- advanced dashboards as add-on seat vs project-level bundle

Can you share a concise price table + any available discount for annual prepay or committed usage? We may have a PO processed in Jan if numbers look reasonable. Also please send a draft SOW so procurement can review.

Thanks — hoping to move quickly here.

Best,
Kumar Santos
Head of SRE, BrightScale
k.santos@brightscale.com
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Kumar Santos <k.santos@brightscale.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 18:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick question: observability add-ons pricing for retention + tracing

Hi Kumar — thanks for the clear brief.

Short answer: yes, we can structure all three as modular add-ons with committed discounts. Attached is a short pricing sketch (retention_pricing_v2.pdf) and an outline SOW we typically use for onboarding. High-level options:

1) Retention: tiered per-GB/month with discounted bands for annual commit; 90-day tier is our default, 365-day uses archival slabs with a lower per-GB rate but a minimum commit.

2) Tracing: two billing modes — per-trace ingest (good for bursty workloads) or a slab (fixed price for N traces/month). For BrightScale's footprint slab + 12-month commit reduces unit cost ~28% vs on-demand.

3) Dashboards: we offer a project-level bundle (flat price for unlimited dashboards up to X projects) or seat-based (per user) with a discount if purchased with retention/tracing combos.

Can you confirm: 90-day retention target or do you want to evaluate 365-day for regulatory reasons? Also, do you expect trace volume to grow >20% q/q? That affects which slab we recommend.

I'm free for a 30-min sync tomorrow morning PST if you want to walk through the numbers — otherwise I'll follow up with a more concrete table.

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai

Internal notes / recommended offer for BrightScale:

Camila — going off Kumar's numbers, here's a compact offer to put in the SOW:

- Retention: 90d = $0.045/GB-month; 365d = $0.030/GB-month (365d requires 12mo min commit equal to 6TB/month baseline).
- Tracing: slab pricing at $0.60 per 1k traces for the 2M baseline with a 12-mo commit gives effective $0.43/1k (28% off). Per-trace on-demand stays at $0.85/1k.
- Dashboards: project bundle $6k/mo or seat license $60/user/mo; bundle is better if >15 active dashboard editors.

Concessions we can offer: 10% additional on top of committed discounts for a 24-month prepay or if they agree to a cross-product rollout (engaging Dedicated later). Limit concession to first-year spend.

Attachments: SOW_BrightScale_v1.docx (SOW + acceptance clause + billing cadence).

Thoughts: keep concessions time-boxed and tie doc to HubSpot deal stage. I'll prep a clean pricing table for Camila to send.

-Ben

Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention / tracing / dashboards: commitment and pricing offer

Kumar — thanks for the details. I attached a short SOW plus the pricing table Ben recommended (SOW_BrightScale_v1.docx). Summary of the offer:

- Retention: 90-day: $0.045/GB-month; 365-day archival slab: $0.030/GB-month (requires 12-mo min commit at 6TB/month).
- Tracing: slab for 2M traces/month at $0.43/1k with 12-mo commit. On-demand per-trace billing also available.
- Advanced Dashboards: project bundle $6k/mo (recommended) or $60/user/mo.

Discount: We can extend an extra 10% off the effective unit rates for a 24-month prepay or if BrightScale signs a pilot that includes both retention and tracing in year one. The 10% concession applies to Year 1 only and is subject to standard exceptions in the SOW (trial usage limits, overage clauses).

Next steps: if procurement is happy with the SOW I can send a DocuSign link and we can draft the PO. I've also added the HubSpot deal link for your reference.

Open questions on our side: final baseline for log ingest (confirm TB/month) and expected trace growth rate — if you anticipate >30% growth we'll recommend a higher slab or quarterly re-eval clause.

Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
